fab_notes: 1. Material: FR-4, 1.6 mm, 4 layers, JLCPCB JLC04161H-7628 stackup (sheet 2 table).
2. Copper: 1 oz outer, 0.5 oz inner. Surface finish: lead-free HASL.
3. Solder mask green, silkscreen white, both sides. Vias tented.
4. Fabricate to IPC-6012 Class 2. Electrical test 100 %.
5. Dimensions in mm. Tolerances unless noted: outline ±0.2, finished holes ±0.08.
6. Fabricate from the Gerber and drill files of the same revision as this drawing.
7. Minimum trace width 0.20 mm. Smallest hole Ø0.30 (vias) on Ø0.61 pads: 0.15 mm annular ring.
8. The 4 plated mounting holes are not connected to any net; keep them isolated on all layers.
9. No controlled impedance, slots, castellations, edge plating or gold fingers.
bom_notes: 1. INSTALLED BY: JLCPCB = fitted by the JLCPCB assemblers (SMT and through-hole) before delivery; After delivery = fitted by the builder.
2. PROCESS gives the assembly process and the side the part is on.
3. The PB26 switches SW1, SW2 are self-sourced (no LCSC number) and soldered after delivery; see KC-01-1830 item 2.
4. Designators ending $CBB15 belong to the I²C level converter block (schematic sheet 3); R3$CBB15 is a different part from R3.
5. U6 is the stick terminal block; the JH-DX400B-R4 stick (three of its four axes) is wired to it in the panel.
6. Substitutes need the approval of the design authority.

SW1.desc: Push-button switch, 15 × 15 mm, SPDT momentary, RGB LED

place_notes: 1. The switches SW1, SW2 are on the top side; every other part is on the bottom side.
2. The bottom view is drawn as seen holding the board bottom side up (flipped left to right), so the datum is at the top right.
3. Red dot = pin 1 of every part with more than two pins and the cathode (pin 1) of D1. These match the silkscreen marks.
4. U6 (stick): 6 +5V, 5 AXIS1, 4 AXIS2, 3 AXIS3, 2 BUTTON_JOY, 1 GND. Wire the stick button from pin 6 to pin 2; R13 pulls it low.
5. Part centres, rotations and part numbers are in the placement table (last sheet), measured from the datum (top view).
